notes.title: SCP-9735-Alpha – Development Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,
I’d like to share a quick update on the current state of [b]SCP-9735-Alpha[/b].[/p][p]First and foremost: [b]The project is not abandoned![/b] I’m still actively working on it. Since this is a one-man project, progress takes a bit more time – especially because I’ve set the bar quite high for myself while also working with a limited budget.[/p][p]Right now, I’m focusing on a [b]rework of the story as well as the overall game concept[/b]. In parallel, I’m also collaborating with an SCP author to officially integrate [i]SCP-9735-Alpha[/i] into the [b]SCP Universe[/b].[/p][p]I know there haven’t been many updates recently, so I’d like to sincerely thank everyone who continues to wait patiently and support this project. 🙏
Going forward, my goal is to provide [b]more regular updates[/b] to keep you all in the loop.[/p][p]Thank you for your interest and support – you are what keeps me motivated to continue![/p][p][/p][p]~ PeazBlack[/p]
